capability_properties: binds authority to process incarnation rather than raw PID
revalidates path-to-parent identity and final absence before temp reservation
consumes itself before any publication attempt
purpose: carry exact receipt bytes and exact POSIX parent-directory authority across the SQLite reset commit
residual_boundaries: Windows retains a path-based implementation and was not runtime-tested.
A hostile same-UID directory writer is not isolated and may race after any observation.
SQLite commit and filesystem publication are not one atomic cross-resource transaction.
No NFS or other network-filesystem outcome semantics are claimed.
Post-fork C++ publication is not an async-signal-safe API for a multithreaded parent.
